Install the Scanner

iPhone

  1. Open this address in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen.
  4. Open A.C.A.D.I.A. from its new icon.
  5. Complete one tutorial while online to cache the app.

Samsung or Android

  1. Open this address in Chrome.
  2. Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
  3. Open A.C.A.D.I.A. from its new icon.
  4. Complete one tutorial while online to cache the app.

For show use, enable Guided Access on iPhone or app pinning on Android, set media volume, and prevent automatic screen locking.
